invariants.statement: WHEN a negotiation process dies mid-protocol (SIGKILL included), THE SYSTEM SHALL resume the negotiation from the durable event prefix and finish the same run without inventing state the log does not show.
invariants.property: forall kills k: exists prefix p: durable(p, k) and replayed(state(p)) and same_run(finished, k) and no_invented_state(finished, p)
